mapper.sql: select c.config_id, c.institution_id, i.institution_name, c.bank_code, c.bank_name, c.mer_id, c.merchant_name, c.settlement_account_no, c.settlement_account_name, c.basic_account_no, c.channel_type, c.environment, c.verify_status, c.is_default, c.status, c.last_verified_time, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from bank_merchant_config c inner join pension_institution i on i.institution_id = c.institution_id
mapper.select: where c.institution_id = #{institutionId} and c.status = '1' and c.verify_status = '1' order by c.is_default desc, c.config_id asc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into bank_merchant_config ( institution_id, bank_code, bank_name, mer_id, merchant_name, settlement_account_no, settlement_account_name, basic_account_no, channel_type, environment, verify_status, is_default, status, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{institutionId}, #{bankCode}, #{bankName}, #{merId}, #{merchantName}, #{settlementAccountNo}, #{settlementAccountName}, #{basicAccountNo}, #{channelType}, #{environment}, #{verifyStatus}, #{isDefault}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark} )
mapper.update: update bank_merchant_config set institution_id = #{institutionId}, mer_id = #{merId}, merchant_name = #{merchantName}, settlement_account_no = #{settlementAccountNo}, settlement_account_name = #{settlementAccountName}, basic_account_no = #{basicAccountNo}, channel_type = #{channelType}, environment = #{environment}, verify_status = #{verifyStatus}, is_default = #{isDefault}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime}, remark = #{remark} where config_id = #{configId}
